label: GO step after an unrewarded trial (mostly one that ended in S2)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, never at D1 or D2. About 99.8% of activation mass falls on GO steps where the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0); it essentially never fires after a reward, and never when the D1 action or state inputs are nonzero. But it fires on only about 11% of those steps, so precision is low. Restricting to previous trials that ended in S2 raises dev F1 to 0.33 with mass recall 0.84. Rates are also higher when the unrewarded trial follows a rewarded one rather than a run of losses, when the hidden good state is S1 (so S2 was the bad state), when chose_good==0, and earlier in the episode (near zero after trial 90). None of these extra conditions (reward history, value threshold, episode position) pushed dev F1 above about 0.41. The strongest activations occur at GO after a single loss that ends a reward streak, and often come with a choice of a1. Which of these steps actually fire is not captured by any simple observed variable, so this looks like a sparse, history-dependent magnitude code inside the post-loss GO context. Uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=GO & last=a2 S2 u (+3.41), phase=GO & last=a1 S2 u (+2.57), phase=GO & before=a2 S1 r (+2.39), last=a1 S2 u (+1.67), phase=GO & choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+1.26), phase=GO & before=a1 S1 r (+0.91). Lower it: model_act=0 (-7.29), prev_state=1 (-3.32), phase=GO & choice_bin=decile 0 (9 = most a1) (-3.29), choice_bin=decile 0 (9 = most a1) (-3.29).
